cases.title: EXPLODE on pit P3 says P3 is now plain linework and has left the schedule with 6 pipe ends not connected, the schedule loses P3, the six pipes stay, and U brings P3 and its schedule row back
cases.expected: Select pit P3 (109D56) and type EXPLODE: the command line says 'P3 is now plain linework and has left the schedule; 6 pipes now have ends not connected yet. U restores it.'; the pit block 109D56 is gone from the drawing and the six pipes around it are still there; the Pit Schedule has no P3 row; two U (the first echoes PITSCHEDULE, the second EXPLODE) bring 109D56 back on layer STORMWATER PIT and the Pit Schedule shows the P3 row again.
cases.why_not_unit: The line comes from CE watching a real EXPLODE of its own block in a live drawing, and the schedule is read from the real drawing afterwards.
not_automated: The look of the exploded linework (plain lines where the pit was) is not judged: a picture item.
Whether every schedule cell after U equals the cells before is RECORDED, not asserted (card D16 asks only for the P3 row; promote it after a first run shows them equal).
